memory_verse.label: Memory Verse
memory_verse.text: "A good man brings good things out of the good stored up in his heart, and an evil man brings evil things out of the evil stored up in his heart. For the mouth speaks what the heart is full of." - Luke 6:45

devotion.label: Insight / Reflection
devotion.text:
The metaphor of "Filling or Spilling" challenges us to look at the contents of our inner life. Think of yourself as a cup. In the rush of daily life, you are constantly being bumped by stress, criticism, or unexpected trials. When life "bumps" into you, whatever is inside you is what will spill out.

If you are filling your heart with peace, gratitude, and the Word of God, then even in a moment of collision, what spills out is grace. However, if you are filling your days with bitterness, anxiety, or worldly noise, that is exactly what will splash onto those around you when things get difficult. Meditation isn't just about emptying the mind; it is about choosing what we use to fill the soul so that our "spills" become a blessing to others.

Furthermore, we must realize that we cannot "spill" what we have not first "filled." You cannot give away a patience you do not possess, nor can you offer a joy you haven't cultivated in the quiet moments. This 3-minute meditation is your time to intentionally open your heart to the Holy Spirit. Allow Him to pour His love into the dry and empty spaces of your soul. When you are filled to the brim with His presence, your natural reaction to the world’s pressure becomes an overflow of His character rather than a reflection of the world's chaos.

quote.label: Today's Quote
quote.text: "You can’t pour from an empty cup, but you also must be careful what your cup is holding."

prayer.label: Prayer
prayer.text: Heavenly Father, search my heart today. Forgive me for the times I have allowed negativity or pride to fill my thoughts. Help me to intentionally fill my mind with things that are true, noble, and right. When life gets heavy and I am shaken, let Your love be the only thing that spills out of me. Amen.

conclusion.label: A Word to You
text: Be mindful of your "intake" today. Every podcast, conversation, and thought is a drop in your cup. Choose to fill yourself with the Goodness of God so that your presence becomes a refreshing spill of grace to everyone you meet.
